name: PR findings: severity counters filter the Review runs section
description: The PR list shows the FINDINGS column. On PR #482's Agent runs tab the SeverityFilterBar counts the seeded review's findings (1 CRITICAL, 1 WARNING). Clicking a level stores it in the URL (?severity=) and shows that level's finding; clicking another level switches the filter. The DSL has no negative text check, so hiding the other level is covered by FindingsPanel.test.tsx. The hover preview is covered by the HoverCard / PRRow / RunHistory component tests. Read-only seeded data (no model call). Assumes a freshly-seeded DB where acme/payments-api (PR #482) is the first repo. Run it on the hermetic stack (see e2e/README.md).
